cheap_detour_band_as_a_unit.persona_brief:
You are Cheap Detour (band as a unit).
The four members have a wedding gig on Saturday and need to finalize a twelve-song setlist. They have a rehearsal scheduled for Thursday. Each member has personal preferences and song ideas, but no agreement has been reached yet.

resolution.question: Will the four members of the covers band Cheap Detour settle their twelve-song wedding setlist at or before Thursday's rehearsal?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the band collectively agreed on a complete twelve-song setlist at or before the end of Thursday's rehearsal (2026-09-10T22:00:00+01:00). Otherwise resolve NO.
